data.long_meaning: Obadiah means 'servant of the Lord'. This Hebrew name is mentioned in the Old Testament, specifically in the Book of Obadiah. Obadiah was a prophet who spoke the word of the Lord against Edom. The name Obidiah carries the meaning “Servant of the Lord” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Obidiah usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of the lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who desire to serve God faithfully.
data.etymology: Obidiah belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of the Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Obidiah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
